command.umbra.shadow: A shadow detached and follows your path.
command.umbra.steps: Someone is walking behind you. Don't turn around.
command.umbra.mimic: That block is not what it seems anymore.
command.umbra.mimic_failed: Look at a crafting table, bookshelf, planks, cobblestone, stone bricks, barrel, furnace, hay bale, log or ore.
command.umbra.darkness: Seeded %s blocks of living darkness (it only lives in dark, enclosed places).
command.umbra.maze: A two-storey quantum maze appeared in front of you. The entrance is on its west side.
command.umbra.home: Home set here. Mimics will move in while you are away.
command.umbra.no_maze: You are not inside a quantum maze.
message.umbra.bad_frame: The frame must be a closed rectangle of dusk stone (inside 2-6 wide, 3-8 tall).
command.umbra.rift: A rift to the Underside opened in front of you.
message.umbra.no_room: There is no room for it to appear here.
message.umbra.only_underside: This only works in the Underside.
message.umbra.freed: The Primordial Shadow is gone. Your own shadow bows to you — from now on it fights at your side.
message.umbra.compass_none: The needle spins: no quantum maze nearby.
message.umbra.compass: The maze is in '%s' — it changes its mind in %s s
journal.umbra.start.title: First page
journal.umbra.start.text: Something is wrong with this world after dark. I will write everything down, or I will think I am losing my mind. Sugar, berries and a scrap of paper: grandmother made a sedative like that. It will come in handy.
journal.umbra.shadow.title: My shadow
journal.umbra.shadow.text: Tonight my shadow came loose. It walks exactly where I walked. When I stand, it catches up; when I move, it falls behind. Light slows it down. Maybe light in my hand would tear it apart?
journal.umbra.shadow_dispelled.title: Light against shadow
journal.umbra.shadow_dispelled.text: It worked. The shadow left a shard behind: cold, humming. Pressed into cobbled deepslate it would darken the stone like dusk. From such stone one could build a door. To wherever it came from. And three sedatives, a crystal and a shard should make something stronger than pills.
journal.umbra.steps.title: Footsteps
journal.umbra.steps.text: Someone walked behind me, step for step. When I turned around, there was nobody. Do not let them get close.
journal.umbra.mimic.title: Not my crafting table
journal.umbra.mimic.text: Something was wrong: the wrong pattern, the wrong sound underfoot. Every kind of mimic has its own tell, and I will write each down as I meet it. Hit first, or shine a light, and it gives up. Never open or mine what looks wrong.
journal.umbra.darkness.title: Living darkness
journal.umbra.darkness.text: Deep down the dark moves by itself. It eats torches. It leaves lanterns alone. Luminite burns it away, and the eternal torches are too much for it.
journal.umbra.maze.title: A maze that looks back
journal.umbra.maze.text: Walls that exist only while you look at them. Turn away and the maze thinks. A compass ringed with echo quartz would probably hear what about.
journal.umbra.sanity.title: Edges of sight
journal.umbra.sanity.text: Figures at the edge of my eye, sounds that are not there. Light helps, and sleep, and warm food. They say answers sometimes come in madness itself. I do not want to find out. I probably will.
journal.umbra.luminite.title: Luminite
journal.umbra.luminite.text: Deep down there is a crystal that glows by itself, and the dark fears it. In glass, a lamp. On a stick, a torch that never goes out. Glass, iron and a crystal: a lantern to hold, fed with more crystals. An ordinary lantern wrapped in crystals and iron should make a flash to strike the dark with. Nuggets, glass and a crystal: a small mirror that shows what is pretending.
journal.umbra.underside.title: The Underside
journal.umbra.underside.text: Ash for ground, stone for sky. No light of its own; torches smoulder and die. The ore here is darker than night: it will make steel harder than diamond. Quartz that echoes, with steel and a shard... seals? Like invitations. And one more thought: a luminite lamp wrapped in steel, crystals and quartz would make a circle of light they cannot enter.
journal.umbra.crawler.title: Crawler
journal.umbra.crawler.text: Climbs walls and leaps out of the dark. A flash of light makes it recoil.
journal.umbra.blind.title: The Blind
journal.umbra.blind.text: It has no eyes. It hears. Sneak. Freeze. It will walk past.
journal.umbra.light_eater.title: Light Eater
journal.umbra.light_eater.text: A pale moth that passes through walls to eat any light. Luminite is too bright for it.
journal.umbra.mimicker.title: Mimicker
journal.umbra.mimicker.text: I heard a cow in the ruins. There are no cows in the Underside.
journal.umbra.shade.title: Shades
journal.umbra.shade.text: Small, weak, never alone. Bright light burns them. Sometimes they leave a shard.
journal.umbra.watcher.title: The Watcher
journal.umbra.watcher.text: It only moved while I looked at it. It is gone now. Its eye is still warm. If I gather all four (eye, crown, crook, mask) and bind them with a block of gloom steel, I will have a key. A key to something behind the gates in the caves.
journal.umbra.mimic_queen.title: Mimic Queen
journal.umbra.mimic_queen.text: She hid among her brood and in the walls of the room. I dragged her into the light. Her crown is part of the key.
journal.umbra.shepherd.title: Shepherd of Darkness
journal.umbra.shepherd.text: Invulnerable in his shroud of dark until light burned it off. His crook is part of the key.
journal.umbra.doppelganger.title: Doppelganger
journal.umbra.doppelganger.text: It wore my armour and walked where I had walked. Fighting yourself is exhausting. Its mask is part of the key.
journal.umbra.architect.title: The Architect
journal.umbra.architect.text: The one who built the mazes; he slept behind the seal at the end of the citadel. The abyss itself beats in his heart, and with that heart I can call the oldest one.
journal.umbra.primordial_shadow.title: Primordial Shadow
journal.umbra.primordial_shadow.text: The first shadow, the one all others fall from. At the end only light could touch it.
journal.umbra.freed.title: My shadow is mine again
journal.umbra.freed.text: Now it walks beside me and strikes anything that comes too close. The nights are quieter.
block.umbra.ward.full: The ward is full of light.
item.umbra.luminite_lantern.empty: The lantern is empty. Sneak + use with a luminite crystal.
journal.umbra.insight_1.title: Insight: whispers
journal.umbra.insight_1.text: I heard them. Not voices: a whisper between thoughts. They told me how to build a table where they are clearer: a book, two shadow shards, planks beneath. It only works while my head is loud. Calm, the words fall apart. The first thing they gave me: a bottle, a shard and a luminite crystal make a tincture of silence.
journal.umbra.nightmare.title: Nightmare
journal.umbra.nightmare.text: I fell asleep and woke up somewhere else. Moving walls, darkness, something close. Up above there was a light: the way out. I think I made it. If I end up there again: find the light upstairs. Sleeping next to a burning ward is probably calmer.
journal.umbra.insight_2.title: Insight: the mask
journal.umbra.insight_2.text: The whisper is louder. Now I see what hides. A carved pumpkin, four shadow shards and an echo quartz at the whisper table: a madman's mask. It will show me the unseen. It will take a little more of me.
journal.umbra.insight_3.title: Insight: despair
journal.umbra.insight_3.text: I am barely me any more. It is clarity. A gloom sword, four shards and two echo quartz at the whisper table: the blade of despair. The less sanity is left in me, the deeper it cuts.
journal.umbra.whisper.2: you are not writing this alone
journal.umbra.whisper.6: it is standing behind you, reading
message.umbra.nightmare.start: You wake up... but this is not your home. Somewhere above, a light is burning.
message.umbra.nightmare.minute: The dream is wearing thin. One minute left.
message.umbra.nightmare.escaped: You touched the light and truly woke up. Something cold is in your hand.
message.umbra.nightmare.failed: You wake up in a cold sweat.
ritual.umbra.nothing: The table is silent. I do not understand anything yet.
ritual.umbra.unknown: The whisper says nothing about this.
ritual.umbra.too_sane: The whisper is too quiet. I am still too much myself.
ritual.umbra.silence_tincture.need: a glass bottle in hand, a shadow shard, a luminite crystal
ritual.umbra.madman_mask.need: a carved pumpkin in hand, 4 shadow shards, an echo quartz
ritual.umbra.despair_blade.need: a gloom sword in hand, 4 shadow shards, 2 echo quartz
item.umbra.silence_tincture.drunk: Silence settles in your head. For a while.
journal.umbra.shadow_village.title: A village that isn't
journal.umbra.shadow_village.text: Houses stand in the ash: crooked, roofless, around a well with no water. They live there. Long noses, quiet voices, all grey, like the shadows of people. They trade for shadow shards and echo quartz; there is even bread. Only, one of them did not blink for far too long. Mirror, flash, or strike first: there are changelings here too. But hit a real one by mistake and it will be hard to forget.
message.umbra.citadel.enter: The walls close behind you. Somewhere ahead, past the maze, the dark and the books, sleeps the one who built all this.
message.umbra.citadel.sealed: The door is sealed. A key of four parts is carved into it.
message.umbra.key.pull: The key tugs at your hand: the Quantum Citadel, ~%s blocks %s.
message.umbra.key.inside: The key trembles. The sealed door is somewhere at the far end of the citadel.
message.umbra.compass_citadel: No maze nearby, but the needle leans towards a citadel: ~%s blocks %s.
journal.umbra.citadel.title: The Quantum Citadel
journal.umbra.citadel.text: The gate in the cave did not lead down, but up: into a citadel above the ceiling of the world. A maze, then a hall full of living darkness where statues stand. A vault where the chests are hungry. A library. At the very end, a sealed door with the same pattern as my key. One wall in the library whispers: I think you can only walk through it if you have nearly lost your mind. Or are wearing the mask.
journal.umbra.statue.title: The statues
journal.umbra.statue.text: They did not move while I looked at them. I blinked, and they were closer. A flash of light turns them to stone for a few seconds. Never turn your back.
journal.umbra.keeper.title: The Keeper
journal.umbra.keeper.text: Huge, slow, hits hard enough to black out. Sometimes leaps across the whole hall. Light stuns it: that is when to strike back.
command.umbra.nightmare_failed: A nightmare can only be called in the overworld, while awake.
journal.umbra.mimic_crafting_table.title: Mimic: crafting table
journal.umbra.mimic_crafting_table.text: The tools on its sides hang sideways, as if the table had lain down and stood up again. Steps beside it sound sticky, like honey.
journal.umbra.mimic_bookshelf.title: Mimic: bookshelf
journal.umbra.mimic_bookshelf.text: The books are wrong: lying on their sides, spines up. Real shelves never look like that.
journal.umbra.mimic_planks.title: Mimic: planks
journal.umbra.mimic_planks.text: The boards run the wrong way: the gaps go up and down. A floor of it sounds like honey underfoot.
journal.umbra.mimic_stone.title: Mimic: stone
journal.umbra.mimic_stone.text: The masonry stands on its edge, the seams run vertically. The worst ones only give themselves away by the sound of steps, or in the mirror.
journal.umbra.mimic_barrel.title: Mimic: barrel
journal.umbra.mimic_barrel.text: The hoops run lengthwise, as if the barrel had been knocked over and never stood up.
journal.umbra.mimic_furnace.title: Mimic: furnace
journal.umbra.mimic_furnace.text: The furnace door is turned on its side. It never burns, whatever you put in.
journal.umbra.mimic_hay.title: Mimic: hay bale
journal.umbra.mimic_hay.text: The bands on the bale run the wrong way. And it does not smell like hay.
journal.umbra.mimic_log.title: Mimic: log
journal.umbra.mimic_log.text: The bark runs across the trunk, the rings are not where they should be.
journal.umbra.mimic_ore.title: Mimic: ore
journal.umbra.mimic_ore.text: The veins are turned, the pattern slightly off. Start mining and it bites. Only light: one flash of the Dispeller and it gives up.
journal.umbra.mimic_chest.title: Mimic: chest
journal.umbra.mimic_chest.text: Stand next to it and listen: it breathes. Hit it first and it gives up everything it swallowed.
journal.umbra.mimic_villager.title: Mimic: villager
journal.umbra.mimic_villager.text: It did not blink for far too long. The mirror sparks above it. Do not trade with it: strike first or shine a light.
item.umbra.explorer_note.known: You have already read everything they left.
journal.umbra.note_1.title: Note: "Day one"
journal.umbra.note_1.text: There are seven of us. We went through the rift the village spoke of: ash, stone overhead, not one dawn. Marta said one can live here. I am writing this in case she is wrong.
journal.umbra.note_2.title: Note: "Torches"
journal.umbra.note_2.text: Torches die here within minutes. Jan found a glowing crystal in the wall; its light does not fade. We sleep around it like around a fire.
journal.umbra.note_3.title: Note: "The village"
journal.umbra.note_3.text: We found a village. The folk are grey and quiet, they say little, but their bread is real. One of them stared at Jan for far too long. At night Jan went to the well and never came back.
journal.umbra.note_4.title: Note: "The bell"
journal.umbra.note_4.text: The bell rings by itself, and every time someone stands beneath it. Marta says it is the wind. There is no wind here.
journal.umbra.note_5.title: Note: "The statues"
journal.umbra.note_5.text: We saw people made of ash. In the morning there were three by the camp, by evening five, and closer. We left without looking back. You must not look back, that much I understood.
journal.umbra.note_6.title: Note: "The gate"
journal.umbra.note_6.text: An arch in the rock, its doorway glowing. Marta says beyond it is a city, built by the one who built the mazes. She wants to find a way out there. I want to find Jan.
journal.umbra.note_7.title: Note: "The library"
journal.umbra.note_7.text: One wall in the library whispers. Marta walked through it; she was already unwell then. I could not: I am still too much myself. She came back with a key drawn on her palm.
journal.umbra.note_8.title: Note: "The last one"
journal.umbra.note_8.text: There are two of us left, and Marta is no longer Marta: she looks at me the way that villager looked at Jan. If you are reading this, shine a light in her face. If that does not help, run to the seal. The key has four parts. I am sorry.
item.umbra.despair_blade.bonus: Right now: +%s damage from lost sanity
message.umbra.ally.stay: Your shadow stays here on guard.
